agenda_text:
City of Inglewood
  Finance Department
  (310) 412-5257

  AGENDA
  CLAIMS REVIEW COMMITTEE
  July 27, 2020

11:30 a.m. – Finance Executive Conference, 1th Floor

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
Persons wishing to address the Inglewood Claims Review Committee on any item on the agenda may do
so at this time.

  1. Approve the minutes of the July 13, 2020, meeting.

  2. Monjaras & Wismeyer Group Inc. – Executive session to discuss recommend payment
  for services provided for Human Resource Department.

  3. Hillcrest Medical Clinic. – Executive session to discuss recommend payment for the
  services of pre-employment and DMV exams.

  4. Joe Schutte – Executive session to discuss recommend payment for the pool
  maintenance services at the Edward Vincent, Jr. Park.

Closed Session - Confidential
  1. Closed session-Confidential-Attorney/Client Privileged; Executive closed session Claims
  Review Committee with Legal Counsel regarding pending litigation pursuant to California
  Government Code §54956.9(d)(2)); Ronald Austin v. Inglewood Police Department LASC
  Case No 19STCP05243.

.

Public Comments Regarding Other Matters
Persons wishing to address the Claims Review Committee on any matter connected with City business not
elsewhere considered on the agenda may do so at this time.

  Adjournment.

  Distribution
  Campos, K
  Heaney, M.
  Horton, Y.

  Dept. Representative
  Jose Cortes
  Sabrina Barnes
